name: ClouDNS Free DNS
free_limit: 1 DNS zone, 50 DNS records, 500,000 monthly DNS queries, 4 unicast DNS servers, 1 mail forward and 1 Dynamic DNS hostname.
watch_out: Only unicast nameservers are included. Anycast, DNSSEC, DNS failover and higher quotas are paid features. Commercial-use rights and card requirements for permanent Free DNS need confirmation.
